column1: # NO_ORACLE_ANSWER (Lon 2026-10-11 16:0x CDT, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "Exclude any program in which we have no way to get output from an
# oracle, or in which we do not know the answer."; ceo CEO-1696, RULES.md FACT RULE A PROGRAM WITH NO ORACLE ANSWER IS EXCLUDED, NEVER DEBT):
# every program UNGRADABLE.tsv names -- the oracle refuses it, crashes, aborts, hangs or cannot run it, or answers differently on two runs -- leaves
# the denominator, named here with UNGRADABLE.tsv's own class and measurement verbatim; UNGRADABLE.tsv keeps the measurement (the coo 2026-10-14).

column3: UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: gprolog 1.6.0 (gprolog_bin since CEO-1598) refuses to compile it: foreign.pl:45 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate '$force_foreign_link'/0, compilation failed (1.4.5 failed it at foreign.pl:50-52, '$call_c'/1 not allowed in this mode)

UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: the stub GNU links when line editing is configured out; gprolog 1.6.0 links le_interf.pl in its place and refuses to compile this one: no_le_interf.pl:41 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate '$use_le_interf'/0, compilation failed -- no oracle run executes this file's code

UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: the stub GNU links when sockets are configured out; gprolog 1.6.0 links sockets.pl in its place and refuses to compile this one: no_sockets.pl:41 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate '$use_sockets'/0, compilation failed -- no oracle run executes this file's code

UNGRADABLE NEEDS_INTERACTIVE_TTY: the interactive top level (top_level/0, break/0 and the query loop under them) reads its queries from the terminal; measured 2026-10-10 on gprolog 1.4.5 and again on 1.6.0, break/0 with its standard input at end of file opens a new break level without end ({Break Level 1} to {Break Level 1253} in 10 s on 1.4.5, then killed), so no fixed standard input gives the oracle an answer to cut

UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: the Ciao Prolog shim of pl2wam; gprolog 1.6.0 refuses to compile it: ciaolib.pl:5 fatal error, invalid module name (library(prolog_sys)) should be an atom, compilation failed -- its use_module/2 directive is Ciao's own (1.4.5 the same)

UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: pl2wam's compatibility layer for a host that is not GNU Prolog, and it defines GNU's own built-ins; gprolog 1.6.0 refuses to compile it: compat.pl:6-13 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate prolog_file_name/2, compilation failed

UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: the SICStus shim of pl2wam, and it defines GNU's own built-ins; gprolog 1.6.0 refuses to compile it: sicslib.pl:10-11 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate g_assign/2, compilation failed

UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: the SWI shim of pl2wam, and it defines GNU's own built-ins; gprolog 1.6.0 refuses to compile it: swilib.pl:10-11 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate callable/1, compilation failed

UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: gprolog refuses to compile it, 1.6.0 as 1.4.5: whole.pl:3 fatal error, cannot open file bip_list.pl - does not exist, compilation failed; bip_list.pl was a file the 2001 build generated (gprolog NEWS: fix bug in pl2wam to include break/0, trace/0,... in bip_list.pl) that nothing in the current GNU source makes or ships
